name: Free sources - GitHub, Hugging Face, arXiv leads (Cloud)

parameters.jsCode:
// Plan me se sirf github wali lines
return $('Plan source calls').all().filter(i => i.json.src === 'github');

// Plan me se sirf hf wali lines
return $('Plan source calls').all().filter(i => i.json.src === 'hf');

// Plan me se sirf arxiv wali lines
return $('Plan source calls').all().filter(i => i.json.src === 'arxiv');

// sirf naye leads (helper fields hata ke)
return $input.all().filter(i => i.json._kind === 'lead').map(i => { const { _kind, _stats, ...row } = i.json; return { json: row }; });

parameters.content:
## Free sources: GitHub + Hugging Face + arXiv -> Leads tab (FREE)
Har 6 ghante (2:25, 8:25, 14:25, 20:25).
Pool ke naam/keywords se source apne aap: developer/data/AI pools -> GitHub, AI pools -> Hugging Face + arXiv. Naye pool ke liye kuch badalna nahi.
Leads tab me jaate hain (status New). Scraping workflow har ghante 10 leads ka LinkedIn dhoondhta hai; jinka LinkedIn link GitHub par hai wo seedhe candidate.
Credential: 'GitHub search' node -> Header Auth: Name = Authorization, Value = Bearer <GitHub token>.
Settings: 'Plan source calls' me GH_PER_RUN, HF_PER_RUN, AX_PER_RUN.
